title: A Prospective, Epidemiologic and Multicentre Trial to Determine the Cardiovascular Risk, New Cardiovascular Events and the Cardiovascular Diseases in HIV-infected Patients: 15 Year Follow up
summary: The HIV/HEART Aging study (HIVH) is an ongoing, prospective, multicentre trial that was conducted to assess the incidence, the prevalence and the clinical course of cardiovascular diseases (CVD) in HIV-infected patients.

interventions.name: HIV positive people are examined every two and a half years for cardiovascular diseases.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age > 18 Years
- diagnosed HIV-Infection
- Signed inform consent
Exclusion criteria:
- acute heart failure or cardiovascular event within the last 3 weeks before inclusion
-Pregnancy
- new AIDS-defining illness within the last 3 weeks before inclusion
